name: Annual Leave
description: Leave provided for vacation personal travel and planned time off

name: Sick Leave
description: Leave provided when an employee is unwell or requires medical attention

name: Casual Leave
description: Short duration leave for personal work family commitments or unexpected situations

name: Maternity Leave
description: Leave provided to eligible employees for maternity and related medical care

name: Paternity Leave
description: Leave provided to eligible employees following the birth or adoption of a child

name: Compensatory Leave
description: Leave granted in exchange for approved work performed on holidays or scheduled days off

name: Bereavement Leave
description: Leave provided following the death of an immediate family member

name: Unpaid Leave
description: Leave taken when an employee has no applicable paid leave balance available

name: Study Leave
description: Leave provided for approved examinations certifications or professional development activities

name: Work From Home
description: Approved absence from the office while continuing to work remotely
